title: S02T05 - Add non-TTY fallback and terminal cleanup safeguards
description: Ensure interactive flows fail closed or prompt for explicit flags when stdin/stdout are not TTYs and always restore raw mode/cursor state.
acceptanceCriteria: Ctrl-C and thrown errors leave the terminal usable.
Automation receives actionable errors instead of partial interactive output.
closedReason: Non-TTY fallback and terminal cleanup safeguards are implemented and tested.
